mentions.name: AI Benchy
mentions.description: This is a benchmark and leaderboard site for AI models, built to measure real-world performance beyond standard published benchmarks. It was motivated by models like MiniMax M2.5 that scored well on standard benchmarks but performed poorly in practice, burning through hundreds of thousands of reasoning tokens per request.
mentions.problem: Standard AI benchmarks don't reflect practical performance; models can score well on benchmarks yet perform poorly in practice and consume excessive reasoning tokens per request.
